elements.element: The obligations apply upon expiry or termination of the Agreement.
elements.evidence: Section (d) applies “[u]pon expiry or termination of this Agreement for any reason.”
Garman must “provide reasonable transition assistance” at Sparkling's request.

elements.element: Transition assistance must be available for up to six months.
elements.evidence: The assistance is required “for up to six (6) months.”

elements.element: Transition assistance must be provided at Vendor's then-current rates.
elements.evidence: The assistance is expressly provided “at Garman's then-current rates.”

elements.element: Vendor must return Customer Data to Customer.
elements.evidence: Garman must “return to Sparkling all of Sparkling's data in Garman's possession or control.”

elements.element: Customer Data must be returned within 30 days after expiry or termination.
elements.evidence: The return is required “within thirty (30) calendar days of such expiry or termination.”

elements.element: Customer Data must be returned in a standard machine-readable format.
elements.evidence: The clause requires return in “a commonly used, machine-readable format,” which satisfies the standard machine-readable-format requirement.

elements.element: Vendor must delete Customer Data after returning it.
elements.evidence: After the return obligation, Garman must “thereafter delete such data from its systems.”

elements.element: Vendor must certify deletion of Customer Data after deletion.
elements.evidence: Garman must “certify such deletion to Sparkling in writing” after deleting the data.

elements.element: Transition assistance must be provided upon expiry or termination.
elements.evidence: Section (d) requires transition assistance upon expiry or termination for any reason.

elements.element: Transition assistance must be available for at least 90 days.
elements.evidence: Assistance is available for up to six months, which exceeds the 90-day fallback period.

elements.element: Vendor must export or return Customer Data to Customer upon expiry or termination.
elements.evidence: Garman must return all Sparkling data in its possession or control to Sparkling.

elements.element: The data export or return must occur within 30 days after expiry or termination.
elements.evidence: The clause expressly imposes a thirty-calendar-day deadline.

result.reason: The added clause fully implements the preferred position and therefore also exceeds the fallback. It covers any expiry or termination, six months of requested transition assistance at then-current rates, return of Sparkling's data within 30 days in a commonly used machine-readable format, subsequent deletion, and written certification. The request condition is customer-controlled and appropriate for transition assistance. The redline adds only the exit mechanics needed for the preferred position and does not disturb the existing termination, perpetual-license, refund, or survival provisions.
